title: Differential characteristics and factor evaluation of microbial structure of rural household toilets excrement in China
description: The research on the composition of the human fecal microbial community after treatment in rural household toilets is unclear, resulting in ambiguous effects and risks of using the recycled products as fertilizers in agriculture.It is urgent to clarify the characteristic of microbial communities in the household toilets excrement and their influencing factors to ensure the safe use in agriculture.Here we investigated the microbial community structure of the excrement of Chinese rural household toilets on a spatial scale, and evaluated the impact of geochemical factors on bacterial and fungal communities in human excrement
